description:
libilbm ILBM File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of libilbm. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the parsing of ILBM files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-27792.

An OS command Injection issue exists in Air Terminal 6 provided by SoftBank Corp. Arbitrary commands may be executed with the root privilege by a user who can log in to the web management console of the affected product.

The Oxygen MyData for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 3.0.9 does not have proper authorisation, nor validate the authenticity of the request, on one of its payment callbacks, allowing unauthenticated users to mark arbitrary WooCommerce orders as completed.

In Progress® Telerik® Reporting prior to version 20.3.26.1110, a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the .NET Framework report designers allows a local attacker with low privileges to execute arbitrary code in the context of the designer process when the user performs certain editing operations.

An input and authorization validation vulnerability in Gaia Portal backend handlers could allow an authenticated, non-administrative user to perform privileged operations that should be restricted to administrators.

A vulnerability in the administration REST interface of Azul Payara allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass secure-admin remote-access restrictions by supplying an arbitrary value in the X-GlassFish-authToken HTTP header. The header's presence waives the remote-rejection check before the token is validated, and an invalid token falls through to password-based authentication, which succeeds without credentials on default domains configured with an empty administrative password. Successful exploitation grants execution of arbitrary administrative commands, equivalent to complete compromise of the server.

The Crop Thumbnails WordPress plugin before 1.10.0 does not perform object-level authorization when reading and re-cropping media attachments, allowing any authenticated user with the upload capability (the Author role by default) to read the metadata of, and overwrite the generated thumbnail files and stored metadata of, media attachments belonging to other users.

The Photo Gallery by 10Web  WordPress plugin before 1.8.49 does not escape a shortcode attribute that sets a gallery watermark image before rendering it into an HTML image attribute, and decodes percent-encoded characters in the value, allowing users with Contributor-level access and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting that executes in the browser of any user, including an administrator, who views the published gallery.

Hyper E-Commerce Infrastructure - dealer integration, and Hyper Teknoloji Ltd. Şti. Hyper E-Commerce Infrastructure - Storefront application and management panel allows Password Recovery Exploitation.

This issue affects Hyper E-Commerce Infrastructure: before 1.1; Hyper E-Commerce Infrastructure - dealer integration: before 1.2; Hyper E-Commerce Infrastructure - Storefront application and management panel: before 2.1796.

description: The Descope WordPress plugin before 1.2.0 does not validate the authentication token it receives before creating a WordPress session, accepting any non-empty token, so an unauthenticated attacker can obtain a session for any existing account, including an administrator, by supplying that account's email address.

UNIX symbolic link (symlink) following vulnerability in openEuler iSulad on Linux.

This vulnerability is associated with program file src/daemon/modules/spec/specs_mount.c.



This issue affects iSulad: through 2.1.6.



If an attacker can get the victim or the platform to run their crafted malicious image, they can cause the iSulad daemon to copy sensitive host directories into an anonymous volume when creating a container, which the container can then read.

Use of Externally-Controlled format string vulnerability in openEuler iSulad on Linux.

This vulnerability is associated with program file src/daemon/modules/image/oci/oci_load.c.



This issue affects iSulad: through 2.1.6.



When the iSulad daemon performs container lifecycle operations (such as create, start, exec, stop, etc.) through the isula runtime (shim), the daemon reads the stderr output of the shim process via a pipe for error information display. If the buffer contains format specifiers such as %s, %x, or %n, it may trigger a format string vulnerability, potentially leading to information leakage, denial of service, or the risk of arbitrary writes.

Relative path traversal vulnerability in openEuler iSulad on Linux.

This vulnerability is associated with program file src/daemon/modules/image/oci/oci_load.c.



This issue affects iSulad: through 2.1.6.



In oci_load.c, oci_load_process_manifest() does not sanitize the Config path of manifest.json. A malicious tar package can enable the isulad with the root permission to read any file on the host.

Missing release of memory after effective lifetime vulnerability in openEuler iSulad on Linux.

This vulnerability is associated with program file src/daemon/modules/spec/specs_mount.c.



This issue affects iSulad: through 2.1.6.



The memory leak vulnerability causes the iSulad daemon to be triggered frequently, exhausting the host machine's memory and ultimately leading to an OOM crash of the daemon, resulting in a denial of service (DoS).

Hyper E-Commerce Infrastructure - dealer integration, and Hyper Teknoloji Ltd. Şti. Hyper E-Commerce Infrastructure - Storefront application and management panel allows Authentication Bypass.

This issue affects Hyper E-Commerce Infrastructure: before 1.1; Hyper E-Commerce Infrastructure - dealer integration: before 1.2; Hyper E-Commerce Infrastructure - Storefront application and management panel: before 2.1796.

The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the Save method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-29161.

In affected versions of Octopus Server, insufficient validation of custom claims on OIDC accounts allowed a user with permission to edit accounts to cause Octopus Server to issue signed OIDC tokens that impersonate a different project. This could grant access to external systems, such as cloud providers or other Octopus instances, that trust that project's identity.

description: The WP Directory Kit WordPress plugin before 1.6.3 does not properly sanitise and escape a parameter used to order results on one of its admin screens before using it in a SQL statement, relying on a keyword deny-list whose replacement order can be bypassed, making it possible for users holding the WP Directory Kit WordPress plugin before 1.6.3's custom Listing Admin role, and above, to perform SQL injection attacks.

The Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads WordPress plugin before 8.11.1 does not prevent a listing's own author from changing its status from pending to published, allowing users with a Subscriber-level account and above to bypass the administrator's listing moderation and publish their own pending listings.
products: Unknown / Directorist: AI-Powered Business Directory, Listings & Classified Ads

description: Akaunting 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in custom invoice payment terms. An authenticated Manager can save a crafted custom payment-term value. When an authorized user opens Invoice Settings for the same company, Akaunting inserts the stored value into a client-side event-handler expression, causing attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in the victim's authenticated origin.

Philips Hue Bridge Pro Argument Injection Restricted File Write Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to modify files on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge Pro. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code within a container on the target system, in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the factory data service, which listens on TCP port 5001 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to modify files in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-33090.

Philips Hue Bridge Pro SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge Pro. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed.

The specific flaw exists within the HTTP service, which listens on TCP port 443 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-33089.

Akaunting 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability through invoice import. An authenticated user with invoice-creation permission can import HTML in an invoice status field. When another authenticated user opens that invoice's edit form, Akaunting renders the stored status in a hidden input with raw Blade output, allowing attacker-controlled markup to execute in the victim's Akaunting origin.

In Progress® Telerik® Reporting prior to version 20.3.26.1110, improper restriction of XML external entity references in the SVG processing engine allows an authenticated attacker with low privileges who can supply SVG content to a report to read local or UNC files, or trigger server-side network requests, from the report rendering host. External XML entities in SVG content were resolved without applying the configured strict resource resolver and report path validation. Disclosed content is limited by the permissions of the rendering process and by what the rendered report output exposes.

The Defender Security  WordPress plugin before 6.4.1 does not verify that the client IP address it derives for its firewall and lockout decisions actually originates from a trusted source, trusting a user-supplied value by default, allowing unauthenticated attackers to spoof their IP address and evade IP-based protections such as login lockout and IP banning, impersonate an allowlisted address, and poison the Defender Security  WordPress plugin before 6.4.1's activity logs.

The Defender Security  WordPress plugin before 6.4.1 does not limit the number of failed two-factor authentication attempts in its default configuration, allowing an attacker who already knows a victim's password to brute-force the one-time code and defeat the second authentication factor.

On Scalable Platforms, an administrator with permissions to edit and install the Access Control Policy and NAT rules can create a NAT rule that redirects traffic to the Gateway's Sync interface, bypassing the built-in Sync protection. This could allow the administrator to execute operating system commands and write files on the Gateway with superuser privileges.
An unauthenticated attacker can bypass authentication controls to access restricted resources on the Citrix NetScaler Console appliance

The AskAny  WordPress plugin before 2.2.1 does not verify that a chat session belongs to the requester before returning or changing it, allowing unauthenticated users who obtain or guess another visitor's session identifier to read that visitor's chat transcript, name, email address and IP address, and to add messages to their conversation or overwrite their details.

Trimble SketchUp SKP File Parsing Use-After-Free Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Trimble SketchUp. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the parsing of SKP files. The issue results from the lack of validating the existence of an object prior to performing operations on the object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-30421.

The Abilities Bridge WordPress plugin before 1.4.2 does not require a valid nonce before re-authenticating a REST API request from the logged-in session cookie, allowing attackers to make a logged-in administrator perform any REST API action, including creating a new administrator account and taking over the site, by tricking them into opening a crafted page (CSRF).

Philips Hue Bridge Pro Protection Mechanism Failure Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge Pro. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HTTP service, which listens on TCP port 443 by default. The issue results from the failure to apply a protection mechanism. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-33086.

The Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket (/tmp/dynamic_socket) without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.

The ContentPen WordPress plugin before 1.1.1 discloses its REST API key to unauthenticated users, who can then use it to create posts containing unfiltered JavaScript, leading to Stored XSS that executes in the browser of any visitor, including administrators.

The WP Remote Users Sync WordPress plugin before 2.3.0 does not restrict which user metadata keys may be written through its incoming user synchronisation requests, allowing a site that holds the shared synchronisation keys to set the capabilities of any existing account and escalate it to administrator.

Improper verification of the source of a communication channel vulnerability in Opera Neon on macOS and Windows allows a malicious browser extension to take control of the browser by sending commands through MCP Hub to the built-in Browser Operator extension. This issue affects Opera Neon MCP Hub extension: 0.0.1.

Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') vulnerability in Apache Sling XSS. xssAPI.getStyleToken() accepts markup in unquoted urls.



This issue affects Apache Sling XSS: before 2.4.14.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.4.14, which fixes the issue.
products: Apache Software Foundation / Apache Sling XSS

description: Gutenverse Form plugin for WordPress before 3.2.2 contains a CSV formula injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject spreadsheet formula-trigger characters by submitting free-text field values to the public form-submit REST route, which sanitizes input with sanitize_text_field() without stripping characters such as =, +, @, or a leading minus. Attackers can store malicious formulas in entry-data post meta that are later exported unneutralized via fputcsv() or esc_html() in the CSV export functions, causing the formula to execute when an administrator opens the exported file, enabling data exfiltration to an attacker-controlled URL or command execution on the administrator's workstation.
products: Jegstudio / Gutenverse Form – Contact Form Builder, Block Form & Booking Form

description: Out-of-bounds Read vulnerability in the Guththila XML parser wrapper of Apache Axis2/C. On some malformed XML input the Guththila parser returned a raw input byte in place of an event code, and the AXIOM reader wrapper used that value as an index into a ten-entry lookup table without checking its range, reading heap memory past the end of the table. An unauthenticated client could trigger this by sending a crafted XML request to a server built with Guththila, the default parser, causing the request to be parsed incorrectly or, in some cases, the process to crash. The memory read is not returned to the client. This issue affects Apache Axis2/C: through 2.0.0. The fix is available in commits 23110287924e79d05a5b4712298c355d1f05c606 and f01683ec10e8fddb87279ec9351b3239021223e6 and will be included in the next release.

In affected versions of Octopus Server, incorrect validation of the external identity linked to a newly registered user could result in that user receiving the LDAP-mapped team memberships and associated permissions of another user. This issue only affects instances with LDAP authentication enabled and LDAP groups mapped to Octopus teams.

In affected versions of Octopus Server, incorrect validation of changes a user made to their own LDAP identity allowed them to edit that identity even when an Administrator had disabled self-service identity editing. This could result in the user gaining membership of teams mapped to external LDAP groups they do not belong to, and potentially escalating to full administrative privileges if any of those teams are privileged.

The TI WooCommerce Wishlist WordPress plugin before 2.0.7 does not sanitise and escape user input before using it in a SQL statement in a front-end endpoint, allowing unauthenticated users to perform SQL injection attacks.

The TI WooCommerce Wishlist WordPress plugin before 2.13.0 does not verify that a visitor who is not logged in owns a registered user's wishlist before letting them manage it, allowing unauthenticated users who know or guess a wishlist's share key to delete items from other customers' wishlists.

The Mine CloudVod WordPress plugin before 2.6.6 does not verify that an order belongs to the requesting user before returning its payment status, allowing any authenticated user, such as subscriber, to read other customers' order status, the purchased item and, while an Alipay payment is in progress, the buyer's Alipay account identifier.

The Mine CloudVod WordPress plugin before 2.6.6 does not restrict who can request cloud storage upload credentials from several of its REST API routes, allowing unauthenticated attackers to obtain signed upload policies and temporary credentials for the site's configured Alibaba Cloud OSS, Tencent Cloud COS and Dogecloud accounts and use them to upload or overwrite files in the site's storage.

The Order Tracking  WordPress plugin before 3.6.2 does not verify that a visitor owns the customer or sales representative account whose orders they request, and the account numbers default to sequential values, allowing unauthenticated users to retrieve the order history of every customer and sales representative, including order contact email addresses in some versions.

description: The Clockinator Lite WordPress plugin before 1.1.0 does not restrict access to several of its record deletion actions, and uses a user-supplied table name in a SQL query without validating or escaping it, allowing unauthenticated users to perform SQL injection attacks, deleting data from any database table and extracting sensitive information such as password hashes.

The Clockinator Lite WordPress plugin before 1.1.0 does not check authorisation or ownership when updating leave requests, allowing unauthenticated users to modify any leave record, including approving or rejecting requests and reassigning them to other users.
An incorrect authorization vulnerability in the Security Advisor in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.3.2-86009-5 and 7.4.1-90080-1 allows remote attackers to read specific files.

An authenticated user with the Create Query Reports permission could exploit specially crafted database queries to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying server.

BookStack before 26.09.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ImageController::checkImagePermission() that allows authenticated non-admin users to bypass page-level content restrictions for images whose owning page has been moved to the recycle bin, because the permission check relies on Page::getPage() which returns null for soft-deleted pages and silently skips the PageView check. Attackers can enumerate sequential image IDs via GET /images/edit/{id} to disclose metadata of restricted images, and users with image-update-all/image-delete-all privileges can rename, replace, or permanently delete images belonging to content they cannot view, persisting the damage even after the page is restored.

A host key verification flaw was found in ansible-pylibssh and in the ansible.netcommon libssh connection plugin. When trust-on-first-use is enabled (host_key_auto_add on the libssh connection plugin, or AutoAddPolicy in ansible-pylibssh), a host that is already present in known_hosts but now presents a different key is accepted without warning. The pylibssh Session.verify_knownhost() method passes the SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_CHANGED and SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_OTHER states to the same missing_host_key() policy hook used for unknown hosts, and the bundled AutoAddPolicy/RejectPolicy classes (as well as ansible.netcommon's MyAddPolicy, which is modeled on paramiko's AutoAddPolicy) therefore add the changed key and continue the connection rather than aborting as paramiko's BadHostKeyException path would. As a result the controller authenticates to the substitute host, runs the play there, and appends the new key to known_hosts, which can disclose connection credentials to an attacker performing a machine-in-the-middle attack. Default configurations (host_key_checking enabled, host_key_auto_add unset) are not affected; non-interactive runs fail closed.
products: Red Hat / Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform 2

description: An incorrect authorization flaw was found in AWX, the automation controller component of Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform. The API access classes for JobTemplate and WorkflowJobTemplate do not check the caller's Credential use_role when assigning the single-valued webhook_credential foreign key: JobTemplateAccess.can_add/can_change and WorkflowJobTemplateAccess.can_change in awx/main/access.py omit the check_related('webhook_credential', Credential, ..., role_field='use_role') call that UnifiedCredentialsMixin.can_attach performs for the normal many-to-many credentials relationship, and the serializer validates only the credential's type and namespace. A user who may administer their own job template (or workflow job template) and use its project and inventory can therefore attach a webhook token credential (for example a GitLab token) that they do not have use permission on. The template administrator can retrieve the template's webhook key; a subsequent webhook event causes AWX to decrypt the attached token and send it in the request header (for GitLab, PRIVATE-TOKEN) to a status URL derived from the event payload, disclosing the victim's token to a destination the attacker can influence. This may disclose another user's personal access token and allow whatever actions that token permits.
products: Red Hat / Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform 2

description: A cleartext storage flaw was found in the AAP Gateway Operator. When reconciling an AutomationController, the operator reads the protected resource-server Secret (Secret/<aap-name>-resource-server, key controller_resource_server_secret) and copies its plaintext value into the generated AutomationController custom resource under spec.extra_settings (RESOURCE_SERVER.SECRET_KEY). Although the operator uses no_log to keep the value out of its own logs, serializing it into the custom resource exposes it to any principal able to read the AutomationController CR without permission to read the backing Kubernetes Secret, breaking the expected OpenShift RBAC separation between the two resources. The value may also propagate into Kubernetes API/etcd storage, GitOps and Argo diffs and history, rendered manifests, support bundles, and audit data. The resource-server secret is intended for trusted Gateway-to-Controller service authentication, and its disclosure may allow a user to impersonate a trusted Controller service and reach privileged service-index APIs.
products: Red Hat / Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform 2

description: A link-following flaw was found in the authorized_key module of the ansible.posix collection, residual to the fix for CVE-2026-11837. That fix guards only the final path component (os.chown with follow_symlinks=False and O_NOFOLLOW in _safe_open_write()). When an unprivileged local user replaces their ~/.ssh directory with a symlink to a directory they do not own, and an operator subsequently runs the authorized_key task as root (a common provisioning pattern), the module resolves its path operations through the symlink: atomic_move() writes the temporary file in the symlink target and renames it to <target>/authorized_keys, creating or overwriting a file in the attacker-chosen directory, and os.chmod(sshdir, 0o700) follows the symlink and changes the target directory's permissions. The written file is chowned to the unprivileged user, so this is not a privilege escalation, but it allows an attacker to create or overwrite files (for example in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/, which APT reads regardless of file ownership) to cause integrity and availability impacts.
products: Red Hat / Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10

description:
Data::Dump::Streamer versions before 3.00 for Perl allow code injection via unescaped Regexp patterns in _dump_qr.

A Regexp's pattern is written into a qr literal without escaping "$" or "@", so "@{[ ... ]}" and "${\ ... }" in the pattern run as code when the dump is evaluated. An already escaped delimiter gets a second backslash, which leaves the delimiter bare and ends the qr literal early.

An attacker who supplies a pattern that an application compiles, dumps and later restores with eval or do can run arbitrary Perl code.

A vulnerability was determined in ToolJet up to 3.20.256-lts/3.21.93-beta. The impacted element is the function activateUserWithPassword of the file server/src/modules/onboarding/util.service.ts of the component Onboarding Signup Endpoint. Executing a manipulation of the argument email can lead to missing authentication. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. Upgrading to version 3.21.94-beta is sufficient to resolve this issue. This patch is called af8f17a745621ae418f1743440f63d315e8b8643. The affected component should be upgraded. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

An integer underflow in Zephyr's IPv4 option handling allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to read stack memory. When replying to an ICMP Echo Request that carries an IPv4 Record Route or Timestamp option, icmpv4_update_record_route() and icmpv4_update_time_stamp() in subsys/net/ip/icmpv4.c compute the length of the already recorded data as ptr - ptr_offset in uint8_t arithmetic. The attacker-controlled Pointer field is checked against the option length but not against the RFC 791 minimum (4 for Record Route, 5 for Timestamp), so a smaller value wraps the length to up to 252 bytes. net_pkt_write() then reads past the 40-byte opt_data stack buffer and up to 213 bytes of stack memory, which can include stack and heap pointers, are returned in the ICMP Echo Reply. A single packet triggers the leak and the device does not crash, so it can be repeated. Devices built with CONFIG_NET_IPV4_HDR_OPTIONS, which CONFIG_NET_IPV4_IGMP selects, are affected.

The Wikidata Lookup expansion module (wiki.py) in MISP misp-modules contained a SPARQL injection vulnerability. The handler function constructed a SPARQL query by directly concatenating the user-supplied text value into the query string without any escaping or parameterization: 'SELECT ?item WHERE { ?item rdfs:label"' + request.get("text") + '" @en }'. An authenticated MISP user with access to the module could supply a crafted text attribute value containing SPARQL syntax (quotes, closing braces, UNION, SERVICE, LIMIT, etc.) to alter the structure of the query sent to the Wikidata SPARQL endpoint. This could allow an attacker to modify the query logic, extract unintended data, or cause the query to fail in ways that expose internal error details. Additionally, the old error handling path formatted raw exception objects into the response string ('wikidata API not accessible {}'.format(e)), potentially leaking internal information such as proxy credentials, query contents, or response bodies. The module also used a spoofed browser user-agent string and the deprecated Wikidata endpoint. The vulnerability required authenticated access to the MISP instance and the ability to invoke the wiki expansion module with a text attribute. The impact is limited to manipulation of the enrichment query and potential disclosure of internal error details; it does not directly compromise the MISP server or its stored data.

A security flaw has been discovered in SiteServer SSCMS up to 7.2.2. Impacted is an unknown function of the file /api/v1/captcha. Performing a manipulation of the argument Value results in inadequate encryption strength. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability has been found in braindecode up to 1.8.1. Affected is the function resolve_type_kwargs of the file braindecode/models/util.py of the component Model Config Deserialization. Such manipulation of the argument Activation leads to use of externally-controlled input to select classes or code. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.0.0 is able to address this issue. The name of the patch is 05b764d93b9a50400f523206fbe03d73d0cf5edb. The affected component should be upgraded.

A vulnerability was found in tjake Jlama up to 0.8.4/0.9.0-beta. Affected by this vulnerability is the function SafeTensorIndex.loadWeights of the file jlama-core/src/main/java/com/github/tjake/jlama/safetensors/SafeTensorIndex.java. Performing a manipulation of the argument weight_map results in path traversal. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

The MISP Modules website component exposes external tool management endpoints (add, delete, change status, and change configuration) that did not enforce the optional administrator authentication policy. When ADMIN_PASSWORD was configured in the application environment, the module configuration endpoints correctly required an authenticated administrator session, but the external tools management handlers processed requests from anonymous users without any authorization check. An unauthenticated attacker with network access to the website could add arbitrary external tools, delete existing tools, toggle their active status, and modify their configurations including API keys and ingestion URLs. This inconsistency allowed bypass of the intended access control for the external tools management functionality. The vulnerability is conditional on ADMIN_PASSWORD being set; installations without an admin password intentionally permit open management access by design. The affected component is the external_tools Flask blueprint within the MISP Modules website application.

Improper neutralization of CRLF sequences ('CRLF injection') vulnerability in ibi WebFOCUS.

This issue affects WebFOCUS: 9.1, from 9.2 through 7, and from 9.3 through 7.

The MISP Modules website component contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the external tools management interface. The /external_tools/list endpoint returned stored API keys (the api_key field) in its JSON response via the ExternalTools model serializer. Additionally, the browser-based edit form pre-populated the API key input field with the stored credential value, exposing it in the DOM.

The /external_tools/list endpoint is accessible without authentication (the regression tests verify the response for both authenticated and unauthenticated clients), meaning any network-reachable client could retrieve the API keys for all configured external tools. These keys are used by the server to authenticate submissions to external analysis or enrichment services, so their disclosure allows an attacker to impersonate the MISP instance or directly access those external services.

The vulnerability also affected the edit workflow: the change_config endpoint previously required the API key to be present and non-empty on every save, forcing the key to round-trip through the client. The browser JavaScript stored the key in a reactive state object and updated the in-memory tool list with the credential value, further increasing the window of exposure in client-side memory and network traffic.

Affected component: the website sub-application of MISP Modules, specifically the external_tools module (serializer in models.py, list endpoint, and the external_tools_index.html template). The impact is limited to confidentiality of the stored API keys; no integrity or availability impact on the MISP Modules website itself is indicated by the patch.

Backup Migration before 2.1.8 for WordPress contains a path traversal vulnerability in its PclZip restore fallback that allows an attacker to achieve arbitrary file write when an administrator restores a malicious backup archive on a server lacking the PHP zip extension. Attackers can craft a zip archive with entry names containing ".." sequences, which PclZip's extract() processes without the PCLZIP_OPT_EXTRACT_DIR_RESTRICTION option, writing a PHP file outside the intended extraction directory into the web-servable tree to achieve remote code execution.

PapaParse before 5.7.1 contains an inefficient algorithmic complexity vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to cause denial of service by submitting delimiter-free quoted CSV input to Papa.parse(). Attackers can supply a single-column quoted CSV with no delimiters, triggering repeated full-buffer indexOf scans per row that grow quadratically with input size, exhausting CPU and blocking the Node.js event loop or freezing a browser tab.

WonderCMS before 3.7.0 contains an unverified password change vulnerability in the saveAction functionality that allows an authenticated attacker to change the administrator password without re-authentication. Attackers can exploit this missing re-verification check during password changes to bypass re-authentication controls and maintain or escalate unauthorized access to the administrative account.

Quest NetVault Backup StnzCreateKey Numeric Truncation Error Denial-of-Service Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Quest NetVault Backup. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the StnzCreateKey function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a numeric truncation error before allocating a buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-28743.

Quest NetVault Backup nvpmgr Integer Underflow Denial-of-Service Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Quest NetVault Backup. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the nvpmgr service, which listens on UDP port 20031 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in an integer underflow before allocating a buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-28744.

The Masterstudy - Education WordPress Theme theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 4.8.151. This is due to missing authorization and nonce validation on the `masterstudy_ms_stm_set_discard_transient` AJAX action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to elevate their privileges to Administrator by setting the `stm_developer_access_token` transient and using the developer access auto-login flow to obtain administrator session cookies.

The CourseCure Courses plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in versions up to, and including, 1.5.1. This is due to a missing capability check in the ajax_save_settings() function, which accepts arbitrary POST parameters and calls update_option() with attacker-controlled keys and values without any authorization verification. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to elevate their privileges to administrator by setting the default_role WordPress option to 'administrator' and users_can_register to '1', then registering a new account that is automatically granted full administrator access.

The VibeBP plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 1.9.9.8.1. This is due to the plugin allowing arbitrary user meta updates through the set_email_notification_settings() function. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to grant themselves administrator privileges by updating their own 'wp_capabilities' user meta value.

The WP Table Builder – Drag & Drop Table Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'url' parameter in versions up to, and including, 2.1.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level permissions and higher, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation by lower-privileged users requires an administrator to explicitly allow those roles in plugin settings. While it is possible to assign subscriber-level roles with the ability to create tables, such privileges are usually assigned to the more appropriate contributor, author, or editor level roles.

An incorrect authorization vulnerability was found in AWX's WebSocket consumer. The consumer_access() function only enforces access controls for object-level event groups (job_events, workflow_events, ad_hoc_command_events) but does not restrict subscriptions to global broadcast groups such as 'jobs-status_changed'. When an authenticated user subscribes to a global broadcast group, the server accepts the subscription without verifying that the user has permission to view the associated resources. In multi-organization deployments, this allows a low-privilege user in one organization to receive real-time job status metadata from all organizations, including job IDs, status transitions, timestamps, and infrastructure topology details such as instance group names, bypassing the organization isolation enforced by the REST API.
